question: In which year was the 'Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana' launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana'** was launched in the year **2015.**
 
• This scheme was launched by the **Government of India **to provide skill training to the youth of the country and make them **employable.**
 
• The main objective of this scheme is to create a **workforce** that is skilled and can contribute to the development of the nation.
 
• The scheme aims to train over **40 crore people** in India by 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **PMKVY scheme's objectives** are to improve the **employability and working efficiency** of potential and current daily wage earners by offering them high-quality training together with **monetary incentives** and benefits.
 
• The **₹8,000 average prize **amount per participant has remained constant. 
 
• The plan would provide recognition to wage earners who already possess a standard level of skill; the typical reward amount for these individuals is between **₹2000 and ₹2500.**
 
• The government has approved an expenditure of **₹120 billion **for this project.
 
• The program aims to train **one crore young Indians** between 2016 and 2023.
 
• Out of the 18 lakh candidates that enlisted for the scheme, **17.93 lakh** had received training as of July 18, 2016.
